# M2-A1 construction handoff

Provisional A1 producer baseline for root inspection before A2/A3 dispatch. This implements the Canopy–Basin simulation/data seam, personal refit, bounded local recovery, save migration and transient bite event. It does not accept this leaf, the composed M2-A batch, M2, or its visible/ordinary-route experience. Narrative details remain in the committed registry and the spoiler-gated specifications; this introduction contains no major reveal.
